text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This aroma... Sirius, might that be<n>Ruhuna tea?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just, the president was telling me<n>the
other day: among Sri Lankan teas,<n>Ruhuna tea is
notable for its rich aroma.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And you like it with one spoonful of<n>milk... Isn't
that right, Sirius?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah, how old do you think I am? I only<n>drink my
tea straight now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf, I think your brain's failed to<n>move on from
childhood. Your penchant<n>for being a control
freak hasn't changed<n>one bit!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Also, out of all the teas, you like<n>Dimbula, the
most mainstream of Sri<n>Lankan teas. Really, I
don't think we<n>could ever get along.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You say that, but I see you know her<n>favorite
tea.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe, Sirius has always had a good<n>memory!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch... What are you laughing at?! Forget<n>it,
everyone scram! Get your<n>entertainment
somewhere else!
